# mattpocock/skills, pinned

An unmodified copy of seven skill folders from https://github.com/mattpocock/skills at commit 4ae2317 (2026-10-31), under the license in `skills/LICENSE-mattpocock`. Aleph's skills of the same names are this text plus small aleph patches. The factory sandbox cannot reach GitHub, so a diff against upstream reads this copy.

To take a later upstream version, replace these folders with that commit's folders and change the commit in this file.
